interface.title: Visualizing the Decomposition of Humeral Orientation into Sub-Rotations (kinematics-vis, main.html)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and interpreting already-captured motion data (post-processing / analysis and teaching)
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a shoulder-motion trial and compare, frame by frame, how different Euler/swing-twist decompositions break humerus and scapula orientation into sub-rotations, using linked animated 3D bone views and time-series angle plots.

data.note: The 'healthy' example dataset is downloaded by fetch_data and served with the app. It has 20 subjects (O45_001…O45_010, U35_001…U35_010) and 8 activities: scapular/coronal plane abduction, forward elevation, external rotation at 90° abduction and at rest, plus weighted versions. The run loaded O45_001_F_47_R Scapular Plane Abduction, U35_003_M_24_R External Rotation at 90° of Abduction, and O45_008_M_66_R Forward Elevation. No test files were available to upload. The run opened the Manual File Selection form but did not load a custom dataset through it.

tree.general: Inspect a recorded 3D joint motion and judge how different ways of splitting an orientation into component angles describe it
tree.specific: Load a shoulder trial and compare the ISB yx'y'', Phadke xz'y'', Swing-Twist and Simultaneous decompositions of humerus (and ISB yx'z'' of scapula) orientation, frame by frame

features.name: Preview-then-commit time scrubber with ghost bone
features.general: Scrub a timeline to preview a time point live (a ghost of the object follows), then commit it so the heavier analysis panels update
features.specific: Drag the top frame slider: the Preview quadrant and a ghost humerus follow, and the frame number shows. Press the down-arrow to make that frame the one the decomposition quadrants animate
steps: Drag the frame slider
Watch the live preview pose, ghost humerus and frame counter
Press the downward arrow to commit
Decomposition views and arcs update for that frame
serves_tasks: Scrub through time and preview the pose
Commit the chosen time point for detailed analysis

features.name: Plot-to-3D linked time selection
features.general: Hover a curve to preview that time point in the 3D views, and click it to commit, as an alternative entry to the same preview/commit model as the timeline scrubber
features.specific: In the lower-right chart, hovering a line moves the frame slider and ghost bone. Clicking sets the decomposition frame and resets the sub-rotation sliders. Zoom, legend toggling and PNG export are stock Plotly and are not part of this feature
steps: Hover a curve point (frame and value tooltip)
Watch the slider and ghost bone move to that frame
Click it to commit that frame
Sub-rotation sliders reset for the new frame
serves_tasks: Pick a time point from the plotted curves instead of the slider

features.name: Stepwise rotation-sequence animator
features.general: Break one 3D orientation into an ordered sequence of elementary rotations and play or scrub each step on the model
features.specific: Each 3D quadrant has step buttons (1/2/3, or 1/2 for Swing Twist, 1 for Simultaneous), a play/pause button and a slider that animates that sub-rotation of the humerus or scapula, with triads, arcs and elbow start/end rectangles
steps: Choose the decomposition in the quadrant dropdown
Click a step number
Press play or drag the step slider
Move to the next step to continue from the previous result
serves_tasks: Step through each component rotation and watch the bone move
Repeat the breakdown for a second body segment
Inspect the axial-rotation component on a rotation-dominant movement

features.name: Multi-view comparison layout with camera linking and maximise
features.general: Show the same object under different methods in several 3D panels whose cameras move together, and expand any panel full-screen
features.specific: Four quadrants, each with a dropdown (Humerus ISB, Phadke, Swing Twist, Simultaneous, Preview, Scapula ISB). Rotating or zooming one humerus view moves the other humerus views too. The Preview view is said to rotate on its own, but the replay did not test this. Double-click maximises a quadrant and double-click restores it
steps: Assign a method to each quadrant via its dropdown
Drag to rotate or scroll to zoom one view; the linked views follow
Double-click a quadrant to maximise
Double-click again to restore the 4-pane layout
serves_tasks: Show a different convention in each 3D panel
Turn and zoom the 3D views together to compare them from the same viewpoint

features.name: Method-comparison plot selector
features.general: Switch a chart between showing every component of one method and showing one component across all methods
features.specific: The plot dropdown offers single conventions (Humerus ISB yx'y'', Phadke xz'y'', Swing Twist, Scapula ISB yx'z'') or one quantity across methods (Plane of Elevation, Angle of Elevation, Axial Orientation, Axial Rotation with True Axial Rotation)
steps: Open the plot dropdown
Choose a convention to see all its angles
Or choose a quantity to overlay it from every convention
Read where the curves diverge over frames
serves_tasks: Plot the same angle from every convention over the whole recording
Plot all components of one convention

features.name: Reference-segment switch
features.general: Change which body segment the angles are measured against, and have every plot and 3D view recompute
features.specific: Open Controls, then Humerus Base: Torso gives humerothoracic angles and Scapula gives glenohumeral angles. The plots and 3D views recompute
steps: Click Open Controls
Switch Humerus Base from Torso to Scapula
Read the recomputed curves and 3D views
serves_tasks: Change the reference segment the angles are measured against

features.name: True-vs-apparent path overlay
features.general: Draw the path a point actually travelled next to the path a decomposition sequence implies, so you can see where the method misrepresents the motion
features.specific: Open Controls, then Spherical Area. On the sphere in each humerus quadrant, blue is the true distal-humerus path and brown is the path the sequence assumes. Only one of Spherical Area and Visualize Angles can be on at a time
steps: Click Open Controls
Check Spherical Area (this turns Visualize Angles off)
Compare the blue true path with the brown assumed path in each humerus quadrant
serves_tasks: See where a convention's apparent path differs from the true path

features.name: Trial picker with database or manual-upload modes
features.general: A modal for picking a recording from a catalogue by subject and condition, or for supplying your own files instead
features.specific: Folder icon opens a dialog with subject and activity dropdowns plus Analyze. 'Manual File Selection' switches to file inputs (Trajectory CSV, humerus/scapula landmark CSVs, humerus/scapula STL, Frequency Hz), and 'Use Database' switches back. The manual-upload Analyze path was not verified
steps: Click the folder icon
Choose a subject and an activity
Press Analyze to load the trial
Or switch to Manual File Selection and choose the five files and the frequency (upload not verified)
serves_tasks: Choose a participant and a movement and load it
